name: Jabil Inc
moat_justification: Real scale, customer integration, and regulated-industry qualifications, but a price-competitive contract-manufacturing business with structurally thin margins, concentrated customers, and EMS rivals bidding for the same programs — limited pricing power, programs can be dual-sourced or moved.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 13 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 8.4%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 9.60 vs 3-yr median 6.78 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 7.2x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: Real AI-driven OE growth and buybacks, moat 4/10 — but at $304.27 the thin-margin OE stream only returns 11.1% weighted (IV@15% $197.16); it clears 15% only well below $197.16, and even the bull case sits under the current price.
moat_for: Global scale and footprint few EMS rivals can match for hyperscaler ramps
Deep customer integration — design, systems integration, supply chain; switching a qualified line is slow and risky
Regulated Industries qualifications (healthcare/drug-delivery, aerospace/defense) with certification barriers and long program lives
AI infrastructure capability stack (power, liquid cooling, photonics, networking), now the growth engine
moat_against: Structurally thin margins — almost no error tolerance
Customer concentration — five largest customers ~36% of FY2025 revenue, one at 16% (cited search results)
EMS bid competitively; customers dual-source and can shift programs to Flex/Celestica/Foxconn
Growth engine is the hyperscaler AI capex cycle — a digestion year hits growth and the multiple together
